description.value: Township 7 Vineyards & Winery is a distinguished BC winery founded in 2000 with two locations; this South Langley Fraser Valley outpost sits in a serene rural countryside setting where visitors can witness a working winery in action and meet the winemakers. The winery is known for small-lot, hand-harvested wines crafted from sustainably grown estate and local grapes, blended from over 15 single vineyards. The tasting room encourages guests to linger over a glass and enjoy a picnic on the property.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the South Langley location at 21152 16th Avenue with phone (604) 532-1766, matching OSM. The site describes a working winery tasting room with a picnic area but mentions no cycling-specific amenities (bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) anywhere in the fetched content. The GM bio mentions personal cycling as a hobby but this is not evidence of any facility amenity.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo-Su 11:00-18:00) do not match website hours (Sun–Thu 11am–6pm, Fri–Sat 11am–8pm); OSM record may be partially outdated.
OSM address lacks postal code and intersection detail; website provides the more complete address '21152 16th Avenue (at 212th), Langley, BC V2Z 1K3'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Township 7 is a legitimate, active winery tasting room in the Fraser Valley that touring cyclists could visit as a destination stop, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A direct outreach or site visit is needed to verify baseline cycling hospitality before including.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website references picnic area ('Enjoy a glass of wine and stay for a picnic!'), which may imply outdoor seating suitable for cyclists, but no explicit cycling amenities are mentioned. General Manager's personal hobby of cycling is noted in the team bio but is not evidence of any facility amenity.
